patches.summary: Import official Fidelity positions and history CSV files into a local SQLite ledger and answer portfolio, activity, change, symbol, and coverage questions from that ledger.
patches.reason: Fidelity publishes no retail brokerage API. The printed CLI is read-only and credential-free; owners download CSV exports and import them locally.

patches.summary: Promoted list commands honor --dry-run, and an empty ledger returns an empty JSON array.
patches.reason: Verify treats --dry-run as a required path. A fresh SQLite file has no rows yet, so the generated empty-database error blocked the dry-run and exec legs.
patches.validated_outcome: verify PASS 34/34 including accounts, positions, and transactions dry-run.

patches.summary: sync explains that there is no retail API and points at import, while still naming the local resources the ledger fills.
patches.reason: The generator emitted a network sync. Calling it would invent a Fidelity endpoint. Dogfood still requires a non-empty population path and live helper references.
patches.validated_outcome: dogfood PASS with 0 dead functions and 5/5 novel features.
